lba_qa.q: The length of a rectangular blackboard is (2x + 3) units and its breadth is (x - 1) units. Find its area as an algebraic expression.
lba_qa.a:
Area = length x breadth
= (2x + 3)(x - 1)

Multiply each term:
= 2x(x - 1) + 3(x - 1)
= 2x^2 - 2x + 3x - 3
= 2x^2 + x - 3

So the area = (2x^2 + x - 3) square units. ✅

lba_qa.q: A square garden has each side (3p - 2) units. Find the area of the garden using an identity.
lba_qa.a:
Area of square = side^2 = (3p - 2)^2.

Use (a - b)^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2 with a = 3p, b = 2:
= (3p)^2 - 2(3p)(2) + 2^2
= 9p^2 - 12p + 4

So the area = (9p^2 - 12p + 4) square units. ✅

lba_qa.q: A shopkeeper's daily income is (5x + 7) rupees and his daily expense is (2x + 3) rupees. Find his daily saving.
lba_qa.a:
Saving = Income - Expense
= (5x + 7) - (2x + 3)
= 5x + 7 - 2x - 3
= 3x + 4

So the daily saving = (3x + 4) rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: Find the value of 102 x 98 quickly using an identity.
Two fields have areas (4a + 5b) and (2a + 3b) square metres. Find their total area.
lba_qa.a:
Total area = (4a + 5b) + (2a + 3b)
Add like terms:
= (4a + 2a) + (5b + 3b)
= 6a + 8b

So the total area = (6a + 8b) square metres. ✅

lba_qa.q: Find the value of 51^2 using an identity.
The perimeter of a triangle is (9x + 6) units and two of its sides are (2x + 1) and (3x + 2) units. Find the third side.
lba_qa.a:
Third side = Perimeter - (sum of other two sides)
= (9x + 6) - [(2x + 1) + (3x + 2)]
= (9x + 6) - (5x + 3)
= 9x + 6 - 5x - 3
= 4x + 3

So the third side = (4x + 3) units. ✅

So the product is 12x^3y. ✅

lba_qa.q: A rectangular plot has area (x^2 + 7x + 12) square units and one side (x + 3) units. Find the other side.
lba_qa.a:
Other side = area / one side
= (x^2 + 7x + 12) / (x + 3)

Factorise the numerator: x^2 + 7x + 12 = (x + 3)(x + 4).
= (x + 3)(x + 4) / (x + 3)
= x + 4

So the other side = (x + 4) units. ✅
